thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered -> P1 autopage to @oncall_jamie. Alert: release rollout v2.4.1 — 5xx spike + latency increase in eu-west-1. rule: deploy->embedder path, 5xx rate 7% over 3m, p95=2.6s. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/dash?panel=embedder

oncall_jamie: ack — I'm on it, standing up my laptop.

sre_miguel: looking now. quick glance at rollout: 20% traffic to v2.4.1 in eu-west-1, new client lib change included. k8s events show a bunch of connection-reset errors on the edge-proxy sidecars starting 10:12 UTC.

infra_ash: nginx upstream logs show 'upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header', lots of 502s from proxy. timestamps ~10:12-10:18 UTC.

product_lina: any confirmed customer impact yet? support_zoe?

support_zoe: saw ~6 support tickets in the last 20m reporting slow generations and intermittent 503/502. small set of paying customers, IDs: #7891, #7892. flagging for comms.

oncall_jamie: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause rollout and revert traffic to v2.3.x, 2) scale up proxy pool, 3) toggle feature-flag. Miguel — can you pause the rollout now? I can handle PD handoff.

sre_miguel: executing pause and scale down of new variant. details:

sre_miguel: ```bash
# pause rollout traffic to new variant
kubectl -n prod patch rollouts/release-v2 --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/paused","value":true}]'
# scale down v2.4.1 replicas to 0
kubectl -n prod scale deploy release-v2.4.1 --replicas=0
```

infra_ash: I'll also adjust the edge-proxy conn_limit and upstream timeouts briefly while we validate — pushing a small config:

infra_ash: ```nginx
http {
  upstream embedder {
    keepalive 256;
  }
  server {
    proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
    proxy_read_timeout 30s;
  }
}
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: Alert acknowledged by oncall_jamie. Escalation suppressed.

oncall_jamie: pause confirmed — rollout paused, traffic shifted back to v2.3.9. monitoring p95 and error rate.

sre_miguel: metrics: p95 fell to ~230ms within 2m, 5xx back to baseline 0.1%. logs show spike correlated with new client's connection behavior under higher concurrency. collecting tcpdumps now.

support_zoe: updated customers in #7891 / #7892: notified we detected an issue with latest release and reverted the rollout. next update in 30m.

product_lina: good. we'll schedule a rollback and block v2.4.1 until RCA. create postmortem, assign owners. Lina -> customer comms, Miguel -> RCA, Ash -> infra tuning.

sre_miguel: initial hypothesis: regression in connection pooling in the upgraded embedder client (v2.4.1) causing premature closes when proxied by our edge. collecting traces and heap profiles, will recreate in staging with traffic replay.

infra_ash: noted. I'll run a focused soak on the edge-proxy with the new client under load to try to reproduce. also checking envoy/nginx versions for known fixes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Resolved by oncall_jamie.

oncall_jamie: closing the live incident — actions: rollback v2.4.1 flagged, postmortem ticket PM-INC-2026-045 created, logs uploaded s3://redwood-incident-logs/3276543210/. Owners: sre_miguel (RCA), infra_ash (infra), product_lina (comms).

support_zoe: leaving customer notes and follow-ups. will coordinate with Lina.

product_lina: thanks all. please add any new artifacts to the postmortem doc and tag me. recommend adding a canary gating check for proxy-level 5xx and connection-reset counts before increasing traffic. :eyes:

sre_miguel: will add tcpdumps, flamegraphs, and a small reproducer.

oncall_jamie: handing off to SRE rotation — I'm un-acking the PD schedule. If anything flares up, create a fresh incident and ping pager again. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed.
